# EBI Collectibles

> EBI Collectibles sells officially-licensed Simplified Chinese Pokémon
> merchandise — Trading Card Game booster boxes and blind boxes, plush,
> figures, and related collectibles — shipped from the United States.

EBI Collectibles carries Simplified Chinese Pokémon TCG sets across the
Gem Set line and the officially-licensed Chinese Scarlet & Violet series,
plus Collect 151 and the 30th Celebration special set. Each set has its
own complete, browsable card list at /sets, with every card's collector
number, rarity, and (where applicable) which cards are exclusive to the
Chinese release versus the English one. Beyond trading cards, the catalog
also includes Pokémon plush, figures, blind boxes, and display cases.

## Card lists

Full, card-by-card checklists for every set carried, including rarity
breakdowns, Chinese-exclusive cards, and release dates: /sets

## Shop

Live inventory and pricing for booster boxes, blind boxes, plush,
figures, and other sealed product: /shop

Best-selling products: /best-selling
Newest and upcoming releases, including open pre-orders: /new-and-upcoming

## Shipping & returns

Ships within the United States only, at a flat rate. Pre-order items are
charged in full at checkout and ship separately once released. Full
policies: /shipping-policy and /refund-policy

## Sitemap

/sitemap.xml lists every indexable page, including each individual set's
card list.
